mandatory_steps: Check university entry requirements (HZB) on the DAAD or Anabin database.
Check if your chosen German university uses Uni-Assist (most public universities do) or their own campus portal.
Create an account on MyAssist (uni-assist.de), upload officially certified English or German translations of high school and university diplomas/transcripts.
Pay the processing fee and submit your application for the Preliminary Review Documentation (VPD - Vorprüfungsdokumentation).
Applicants from China, India, and Vietnam MUST obtain an APS Certificate (Akademische Prüfstelle) before applying for visas.
pro_tip: Apply for your Uni-Assist VPD at least 8 weeks before the university deadline. Once issued, your VPD certificate is valid for 1 year across multiple German universities.

evaluation_system: Declaration of Value (DoV) / CIMEA Statement of Comparability
estimated_cost: DoV is free at Italian Embassies (for study purposes); CIMEA is ~€150 - €250 (express)
mandatory_steps: Submit pre-enrollment on the official Universitaly portal (universitaly.it).
Choose between Option A: Request Declaration of Value (Dichiarazione di Valore - DoV) from the Italian Embassy/Consulate in your country of education.
OR Option B: Request an online Statement of Comparability and Verification from CIMEA (cimea.it) using Diplome blockchain verification.
For Regional DSU Scholarships: Get family income and property certificates translated into Italian and officially certified by the Italian Embassy for your ISEE-Parificato calculation.
pro_tip: Many Italian universities now accept CIMEA online certificates instead of Embassy DoV, saving months of bureaucratic waiting.

evaluation_system: WES (World Education Services) / ECE Course-by-Course Evaluation
processing_time: 7 business days once all certified documents arrive
mandatory_steps: Create a WES profile and choose 'Course-by-Course Evaluation' for graduate admissions.
Obtain your WES Reference Number.
Have your home university registrar send your official sealed transcripts directly to WES electronically or via sealed envelope stamped across the flap.
WES converts your grades into US/Canadian semester credits and calculates an official US-equivalent GPA (4.0 scale).
pro_tip: Do NOT open the sealed university envelope yourself or send personal copies. WES will immediately reject documents that do not arrive directly from your university registrar.

country: Hague Apostille Countries (Hungary, South Korea, Czechia, Poland, Spain)
evaluation_system: Hague Apostille Convention (1961) or Consular Legalization
mandatory_steps: Step 1: Get official graduation certificate and full transcripts certified by your home country's Ministry of Higher Education.
Step 2: Authenticate signatures at your home country's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA).
Step 3: If your country is a member of the Hague Apostille Convention, have the Ministry of Foreign Affairs affix the official 'Apostille' stamp.
Step 4: If your country is NOT an Apostille member (e.g. Egypt, Pakistan), take the MFA-authenticated documents to the target country's Embassy for Consular Legalization (Super-legalization).
pro_tip: Stipendium Hungaricum and Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) will permanently disqualify candidates whose final degree documents lack official Apostille or Consular stamps.

processing_time: Evaluated during university admissions cycle (January to March)
mandatory_steps: Upload high-resolution color PDF scans of original documents AND official authorized English translations.
Provide complete transcript of records detailing all completed courses, grades, and examination dates.
Provide official course descriptions (syllabus) detailing course contents and credit hours for prerequisite audits.
Swedish University Admissions conducts its own in-house foreign qualification evaluation at zero additional cost.
pro_tip: Ensure the grading scale explanation is included on your transcript, showing minimum passing grade and highest possible grade.
